headline: Anthropic Warns of Catastrophic Risk Ahead of Public Share Listing
summary: Anthropic warned of catastrophic risks to humankind in filings ahead of what is set to be the first true artificial intelligence company public share listing.
why: Public offerings from leading AI foundation model developers provide investors with direct equity access to generative artificial intelligence infrastructure.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: High-profile public listings highlight investor enthusiasm for AI while highlighting regulatory and existential risk factors.
